subject: Image 1 is the APPROVED art style and design reference. Create ONE NEW ISOLATED GAME SPRITE of the tiny BLUE HOODED TRAVELER from that reference, not the scene. This is a game-ready new sprite, do not crop scenery. Small round head in pointed blue hood, big simple cloak and little dark brown boots, ochre/golden-brown leather belt and small belt pouch. Back view / slight three-quarter rear looking up and right towards an unseen streetlamp. Only a tiny optional cheek sliver, no visible full face. A friendly stout compact proportion: entire sprite about 24 logical pixels wide and 34 logical pixels tall; hood/head about 13 pixels wide, two little feet. Render as deliberately low-resolution pixel art, enlarged on a clean square grid with large square pixels, no HD detailing. One-to-two native pixel dark ink outline; broad connected blue/navy colour masses, brown belt and boots. Material base colours, NOT night illumination baked into the cloak; avoid hot yellow rim light. Show the hood's round crown, side plane and cloak folds with only a few broad neutral-blue values. No weapons, no walking stick, no lantern or held item, no limbs dangling away from body. Neutral standing pose with both boots touching the same baseline. NO ground, NO cast shadow, NO glow, NO reflection, NO environment, NO text. Entire space outside the silhouette is exact flat bright magenta #ff00ff, no gradient and no fake transparency checkerboard. Center the sole complete character with plenty of magenta margin. Match the visual language and costume of Image 1, not any unrelated HD-2D sprite.
style: Low-resolution rear-view RPG pixel sprite, reference-matched chunky connected clusters, dark ink contour and restrained palette; no antialiasing, no dither, no illustration texture.
lighting: Neutral even diffuse material albedo, no directional warm rim or scene light, no exterior shadow.
